title: Arms and hands swing like a real walk
items: The arm swing follows measured walking: the arm swings mostly behind the body, and the forearm trails the upper arm like a loose pendulum

Hands hang relaxed: each hand is curled once instead of twice (two curls added up to a claw), the fingers bend evenly at every joint and lie together, and the thumb rests beside the first finger without tearing the skin at its root
Each person swings a little differently: how far, how bent the elbow, and one arm a touch more than the other
